named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate's earned ultimate loss estimate for COVID-19 related risks at 31 December 2021 was $65.1m gross and $31.5m net of reinsurance and including reinstatement premiums, primarily in its Accident and Health, Personal Accident Treaty and Credit Risk lines of business.

named_events.event_name: UK Supreme Court FCA business interruption test case (judgment)
named_events.loss_description: UK Supreme Court judgment considered; Syndicate performed a detailed review of business interruption clauses and concluded there is no material impact on the COVID-19 best estimate loss booked for the year ended 31 December 2021.

The directors considered the recent geopolitical situation in Ukraine and Russia. The net impact on the Syndicate's financial and capital position to date, from both underwriting and investments, has been limited. The directors continue to closely monitor the situation.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's gross claims reserves at 1 January 2021 were $498.144m (prior year comparative). Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development of $15.5m (approximately 3.1% of opening gross claims outstanding), i.e. a strengthening of reserves. The reported movements include mixed development by class (notably adverse movement in some liability and marine exposures offset by favourable development in property), with net prior-year adverse movement also reflected net of reinsurance in the claims note. COVID-19 remains quantified separately (gross $65.1m, net $31.5m) and the syndicate continues to monitor geopolitical and legal developments.

In arriving at the level of claims provisions a management margin is applied over and above the actuarial best estimate.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year column (explicit). Prior year development derived from the gross claims development triangle (pages 65-66) by diagonal comparison excluding 2020-2021 columns; therefore PYD is calculated rather than explicitly stated in a single gross prior-year movement note. The claims note provides a net prior-year movement ($8.6m adverse) - triangle-based gross PYD ($15.5m adverse) was used as primary figure. Lob movements are taken from the claims note but are net of reinsurance (reported on a net basis) and therefore are not gross; these are flagged with lower confidence.
